THE RIGHT BEGINNING FOR YOUR CHILD

Every age.
A new discovery.

Choose an age group to explore how we nurture your child's confidence, curiosity and readiness for the next step.

PRE-NURSERY · 2+ YEARS

Their first little world of learning.

A gentle introduction to school, where feeling comfortable comes first. Through stories, sensory play and first friendships, children begin to find their confidence.

  • Communication, listening & vocabulary
  • Sensory play, colours & shapes
  • Music, movement & motor skills
  • Friendships & simple self-help skills

THE KABIRA EXPERIENCE

We see the wonder.
We help it grow.

Learning is more meaningful when children can touch, try, ask and imagine. Our approach brings modern early-years education together with timeless Indian values.

natural curiosity.

A SCHOOL THAT PLANS TO GROW WITH THEM

A beautiful start.
A thoughtful future.

Our journey begins with Pre-Nursery to UKG and daycare. The long-term vision is to grow progressively towards Class X, adding one higher class each academic year.

NOW
